entities.name: Kamahl
entities.description: A strong warrior-mage from the Pardic Mountains lured to Cabal City by the Mirari's call.

entities.name: Chainer
entities.description: A young cabalist who befriends Kamahl.

entities.name: Seton
entities.description: A centaur from Krosa who comes to plead for his forest.

entities.name: Kirtar
entities.description: Order lieutenant who takes the sphere, tries to gain control of the Order with it and dies in the devastation.

entities.name: Turg
entities.description: A frog slave controlled by Laquatus who dies stopping Aboshan.

entities.name: Laquatus
entities.description: Merfolk ambassador plotting against everyone to get the sphere and betray the Emperor.

entities.name: Pianna
entities.description: Leader of the Order, killed in the devastation Kirtar causes.

entities.name: Aboshan
entities.description: Paranoid ruler of the Mer Empire who unleashes the Mirari and submerges a third of Otaria.

entities.name: Llawan
entities.description: Estranged empress who challenges Aboshan's rule.

entities.name: Fulla
entities.description: Cabal dementist who helps Laquatus search the treasury.

entities.name: Mirari
entities.description: An artifact of compelling power that none can resist and only one can hold.

entities.name: Cabal
entities.description: Faction in southern Otaria that runs gladiatorial pit fights; led by the Cabal Patriarch.

entities.name: Cabal Patriarch
entities.description: Leader of the Cabal.

entities.name: Order
entities.description: Military organization controlling the north of Otaria that loathes the Cabal.

entities.name: Mer Empire
entities.description: Empire stretching around the continent, controlled by Aboshan.

entities.name: Otaria
entities.description: Continent where the story takes place, 100 years after the Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Cabal City
entities.description: The Cabal's most important city, home of the pit fights.

entities.name: Pardic Mountains
entities.description: Home to dwarves and proud barbarians.

entities.name: Krosan Forest
entities.description: Forest with increasingly savage beasts.

entities.name: Borben
entities.description: Coastal town where Kamahl settles.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion 100 years before the story.

entities.name: Battle for the Mirari
entities.description: The conflict featured in the novel.

events.summary: Kamahl arrives at Cabal City lured by a mysterious call and befriends Chainer and Seton.
events.quote: There he befriends a young cabalist, Chainer , and a centaur from Krosa, Seton

events.summary: A Krosan dragon attacks; Kamahl lands the killing blow but is pinned under the carcass and Kirtar takes the glory and the sphere.
events.quote: Despite Kamahl being he who dealt the killing blow, he remains pinned down underneath the carcass, and Kirtar takes the glory instead.

events.summary: Laquatus reaches Kirtar at the Order encampment; Pianna demands the sphere and Kirtar plots a coup.
events.quote: The aven reluctantly complies but plots a coup

events.summary: Kirtar tries to gain control of the Order with the sphere but its power devastates the city, leaving him and Pianna dead; Turg takes the artifact.
events.quote: leaving him and Pianna dead, and the city in ruins.

events.summary: Laquatus returns to the Mer capital and stokes Aboshan's fears as Llawan challenges his rule; Kamahl settles in Borben.
events.quote: Llawan , the estranged empress, appears to challenge Aboshan's rule.

events.summary: Aboshan finds the Mirari in his treasury and unleashes its power, submerging a third of Otaria and destroying his capital.
events.quote: submerging a third of Otaria and destroying his capital.

events.summary: Laquatus and Fulla stop Aboshan at the cost of Turg's life and take the Mirari to Cabal City.
events.quote: Laquatus and Fulla manage to stop him before the damage is too great, at the cost of Turg's life.
